xbox360-gta5-boxuga-v2.compatibility: The pinned V2 release labels this Xbox 360 RGH; its pinned README also lists Xbox 360 RGH/JTAG. Exact dashboard/kernel and game update requirements are not specified. This ZIP is separate from the PS3 update.rpf.

guideBlocks.title: Use the Xbox build
guideBlocks.text: Boxuga.V2.Xbox.zip is the Xbox 360 RGH asset from the pinned V2 release. The PS3 update.rpf is a separate release asset. Keep the complete Content hierarchy in this Xbox archive.

guideBlocks.title: Source paths and requirements
guideBlocks.text: The supplied build is Content/0000000000000000/545408A7/000B0000/tu00000009_00000000. The archive includes a zero-byte instruction file whose name says to drag the file to the USB root. Match title ID 545408A7 and verify the game update and environment before replacing existing content. The TU filename alone does not establish a numbered game update.

xbox360-rdr-demonic-v27.version: 2.7 (reviewed post; archive readme does not number the build)
xbox360-rdr-demonic-v27.compatibility: The archive README specifies Undead Nightmare NON-GOTY, Media ID 5B48AF70, region-free. Premade variants are labelled RGH. It explicitly says normal Red Dead Redemption is no longer supported. Exact dashboard/kernel and TU number are unspecified.

guideBlocks.title: Required game edition
guideBlocks.text: The included README identifies Undead Nightmare NON-GOTY, region-free, Media ID 5B48AF70. It says normal Red Dead Redemption is no longer supported. Its patched XEX is described as using the latest title update, without a numbered TU. Preserve this source requirement and confirm the edition and update before replacement.

guideBlocks.title: Choose one premade base
guideBlocks.text: Separate Demonic and Jedijosh RGH folders each provide patch0_xenon.rpf and dlcpatch0_xenon.rpf. The author warns that running both menus together can cause problems. Loose files are also supplied for editing an existing RPF; those require the documented RPF workflow.

guideBlocks.title: Root files and backups
guideBlocks.text: The README places ROOT OF GAME FILES directly in the extracted game root, outside the RPF archives. Preserve original game files. Its RPF instructions require XML, XEDT, XSF and XTD imports to be compressed. No installation was performed during this review.

guideBlocks.title: Included menu controls
items: Demonic: hold RB and press RS to open; use D-pad up/down, A to select and B to go back.
Jedijosh: hold RB and press D-pad right; use D-pad directions, A to select and B to go back.
Some options use different controls displayed by the menu.

evidence.videoPolicy: Original BIK components are preserved inside the original archive. Do not embed or add separate video downloads.

xbox360-neighborhood.compatibility: The source file is the full Windows XBOX360 SDK 21256.3 executable, not a standalone Xbox 360 Neighborhood download or a console-side XEX. Exact Windows-version requirements have not been verified.

guideBlocks.title: Full SDK distribution
guideBlocks.text: This source supplies XBOX360 SDK 21256.3.exe, a 1.53 GB Windows SDK distribution. It is not a standalone Neighborhood application or a file for Xbox 360 console storage. Preserve the original SDK filename and version.

guideBlocks.title: Requirements still unverified
guideBlocks.text: No installer was launched and no development environment or console connection was configured. Check the original distribution’s setup documentation and applicable requirements before choosing components. Windows-version compatibility and hardware connectivity are untested.

documentation.member: Loose Files, Premade Rpfs, Demonic Menu, jedijosh menu [Xbox]\Mod Menu - Script Controls.txt
documentation.text:
Demonic Revelations:
--------------------
Open: Hold RB & Press RS
Scroll: Dpad Up/Down [Some menus support scroll left and right, those menus have buttons on screen]
Select Option: A
Back/Close: B
- Some menus/options have diff controls and they show on screen for them.

Jedijosh Trainer:
------------------
I don't reccomend using demonic and josh at the same time, however it's here just to show the script works.
Open: Hold RB & Press Dpad Right
Scroll: Dpad Up, Down, Left, Right
Select Option: A
Back/Close: B
Instant Close Menu: Hold RB & Press Dpad Right Again while menu open.
- Some options may have diff controls which are shown on screen.


Gamertag Editor:
----------------
Hold RB & Press Dpad Left
Scroll: Dpad Up, Down, Left, Right
Select Option: A
Back/Close: B
Instant Close Menu: Hold RB & Press Dpad Left Again while menu open.


Anthrax Menus:
--------------
Open: Press RB + X at the same time.
Scroll: Dpad Up, Down, Left, Right
Select Option: A
Back/Close: B

Video Loader:
-------------
Open: Hold LB + RB & Press Dpad Down
- menu shows rest of controls

Terminate these menus anytime during gameplay however you wish.
If you have issues loading scripts, terminate all scripts and load the one you want now and it should work.
- RDR Doesnt like alot of scripts being loaded in at the same time.

documentation.member: Loose Files, Premade Rpfs, Demonic Menu, jedijosh menu [Xbox]\READ.txt
documentation.text:
If you use the template files from loose files, or use pre-modded demonic rpf, Online you will auto
be in the modders pool, aka a solo session friends can't join. You also can't find/join other
players unless they are also in the modders pool. You will have to enable modders pool bypass
under misc options in the menu then find a new sesion and you will be out of modders pool.
In the pre-modded josh rpf, I did not include the template files, so import them if you want to
use them with joshes menu, just know you will have to either execute demonic along side it under joshes
script loader to bypass modders pool or you will need to create your own modders pool bypass script.
The template files are only only needed for demonic menu as is so you can play as all animals.

If for some reason you ONLY want to use joshes menu and not demonic at all, in the josh premade rpf
remove the minheightgrid.xml file if you have issues spawning stuff from joshes menu
it's located in navres/territory. This file is only included because it makes teleport to waypoint
work alot better in demonic menu but left it in for joshes just incase it helps with his also but never tested
Demonic was built with this file in mind directly, so feel free to remove it from the rpf if it causes issues
with joshes menu.

.xml files must be compressed in rpf tools for rdr.
.xedt files must be compressed in rpf tools for rdr.
.xsf files must be compressed in rpf tools for rdr.
.xtd files must be compressed in rpf tools for rdr.

ROOT OF GAME FILES
--------------------
Here you have a patched xex to latest TU, you also have clean rpfs you can modify.
Also included is normal RDR bik video files as well as a few custom ones for video loader custom script.
- NONE OF THESE FILES ARE FOR RPFS. They go directly in your extracted game root folder.

Comaptible Game Version
-----------------------
Xbox: Media ID - 5B48AF70: Undead Nightmare [NON GOTY] Region free.


Custom Scripts
-----------------
DRS1 = Gamertag Editor
DRS2 = Jedijosh Cracked Menu
DRS3 = Video Loader
DRS4 = Anthrax Mini Menu (Update 2)
DRS5 = Anthrax Mini Menu (Update 3)
DRS6 = Joshes Standalone ServerFix Script (ported from ps3 to xbox thanks to FuhzBot)
DRS7 = Demonic Standalone ServerFix (removed from menu for space, joshes is better but here if you need it)
DRS8 = Undead Weapons Online - Must be ER Bypassed at game mainmenu for this to work right!
DRS9 = Custom Weapons Online - Must be ER Bypassed at game mainmenu for this to work right!

Semi outdated tuts + tools
---------------------------
[I get tired of remaking tuts people can't follow, I also get tired of remaking tuts each time I add new files]
These tuts could be a bit outdated but they should be good enough to get the gist on what to do.

Basic Tut For Installing Demonic + Some Files: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GA31TSgGfCA
- ^ This tut is outdated mostly because I no longer have support for NORMAL RDR version.
 - I may eventually go back and make it compatible with normal rdr again but it will lack features.
How To Create Videos For Video Loader: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=21nV9ymiSkw
Most Tools You Will Ever Need On RDR1: https://www.mediafire.com/folder/9no115qcmcqgd/Red+Dead+Redemption+Tools

Mod Menu Sources/Script Sources:
--------------------------------
Demonic Revelations: https://github.com/CabooseSayzWTF/Demonic-Revelations-RIP-Edition
Undead Weapons Online: https://github.com/CabooseSayzWTF/RDR1-Undead-Weapons-Online
Custom Weapons Online: https://github.com/CabooseSayzWTF/RDR1-Custom-Weapons-Online
TheRouletteBoi SPRX Menu Base: https://github.com/TheRouletteBoi/RedDeadRedemption
Connors Menu Base: https://github.com/connorms/RDR-Trainer
V3 Mod Menu Base: https://github.com/Foxxyyy/RDR-Menu
- The v3 base originally was made for demonic revelations V3, however due to SSD failures, and issues
- I couldn't figure out, the project was canceled, so instead the base was released publicly.
